title: Fusion power darling Commonwealth Fusion Systems raises another $1B
summary: CFS hasn’t disclosed either Sparc’s or Arc’s price tag, though in 2024, Virginia’s former governor Glenn Youngkin said that Arc would be a “multi-billion-dollar fusion power plant.” This is CFS’s largest round since raising $1.8 billion in 2021.
